def VTask.prev : {α : Type u_1} -> [DecidableEq α] -> (l : List α) -> (x : α) -> x ∈ l → α :=
fun α [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (x : α) (h : x ∈ l) =>
match l with
| [] => absurd h (not_mem_nil _)
| [_] => x
| y :: ys =>
  if y = x then
    getLast ys
  else
    prev ys x h
